plan.title: coverage-debt: restore Vitest branch coverage >=85% after v0.97.0 hairline (84.95%)

narratives.Description: Release Step 5 for v0.97.0 failed solely on Vitest branch coverage at 84.95% versus the 85% global threshold while lines, statements, and functions already passed. This story restores all four metrics to at least 85% without the coverage-debt hatch so the open hatch ledger can close.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary
Release Step 5 (v0.97.0 cut) failed on Vitest **branch** coverage only: measured **84.95%** vs 85% global threshold. Lines / statements / functions met threshold (failure message only named branches).

## Hatch markers
- coverage-debt
- --allow-coverage-debt

## Acceptance (must restore before close)
- [ ] Restore **all four** Vitest coverage metrics (lines, functions, branches, statements) to **≥ 85%**
- [ ] Re-run full coverage lane without `--allow-coverage-debt`
- [ ] Close this issue when green

## Context
- Discovered during `task release -- 0.97.0` Step 5 (`task check` / vitest coverage)
- Prior restore: #3144 (v0.96.0 hairline). No open prior hatch debt at cut time.
- Release skill #2866 open-issue ledger hatch for branch-only miss.

## Evidence
```
ERROR: Coverage for branches (84.95%) does not meet global threshold (85%)
[5/13] Pre-flight CI ... FAIL
```
narratives.UserStory: As a release maintainer, I want Vitest branch coverage restored to at least 85% on master, so that coverage-debt issue #3185 can close and future cuts are not blocked by an open hatch ledger.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Run coverage:hotspots and/or vitest coverage to identify modules with the lowest branch rates. 2. Add or extend focused *-branches.test.ts files (prefer new tests) that exercise both sides of uncovered branches without changing product behavior except where a real bug is found. 3. Re-run the full coverage lane without --allow-coverage-debt and confirm lines, functions, branches, and statements are all >=85%. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #3185; open PR through merge; close #3185 when green.

narrative.Acceptance: Given current master after this PR, when the full Vitest coverage lane runs without --allow-coverage-debt, then branches measure at least 85%.
Given the same coverage run, when thresholds are evaluated, then lines, functions, branches, and statements are each at least 85%.

items.title: No hatch dependency for green bar

narrative.Acceptance: Given the PR is merge-ready, when CI or local full coverage runs, then green is achieved without --allow-coverage-debt for this restore.
Given merge, when CHANGELOG and closing keywords are applied, then #3185 is cited and can close.
